# xpcall

Call a function with an error handler.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `lua.xpcall` |
| Origin | Lua base |
| Category | Lua Base |
| Family | Function |
| Monaco kind | `function` |
| Format | `xpcall(function_name, error_handler)` |
| Valid contexts | `file`, `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `xpcall(function_name, error_handler)` |

## Example

```lua
xpcall(function_name, error_handler)
```
